args.lesson: Worked: the per-notice FTS endpoint api/1.0/ocdsReleasePackages/<id> returns 200 with small files. The HTML /Notice/<id> pages return 403, so use the API. Three verified profiles; all quotes were checked verbatim by EXEC. Failed: my first draft wrongly said Croydon gave no future procurement, because I wrote from an extract truncated at 700 characters. The full text states a future competitive EPR procurement (no date) and 'approximately GBP 17,549,439 excluding VAT'. Next time: never truncate source fields before an absence claim. There are no structured end dates, and demand is unknown.
